items.name: JSON
items.summary: The JSON printer, which emits results in a JSON lines format.

methods.name: get_mut
methods.signature: fn get_mut(&mut self) -> &mut W
methods.summary: Return a mutable reference to the underlying writer.

methods.name: has_written
methods.signature: fn has_written(&self) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this printer has written at least one byte to the underlying writer during any of the previous searches.

methods.name: into_inner
methods.signature: fn into_inner(self) -> W
methods.summary: Consume this printer and return back ownership of the underlying writer.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(wtr: W) -> JSON<W>
methods.summary: Return a JSON lines printer with a default configuration that writes matches to the given writer.

methods.name: sink
methods.signature: fn sink<'s, M: Matcher>(&'s mut self, matcher: M) -> JSONSink<'static, 's, M, W>
methods.summary: Return an implementation of `Sink` for the JSON printer.

methods.name: sink_with_path
methods.signature: fn sink_with_path<'p, 's, M, P>(&'s mut self, matcher: M, path: &'p P) -> JSONSink<'p, 's, M, W> where M: Matcher, P: ?Sized + AsRef<Path>
methods.summary: Return an implementation of `Sink` associated with a file path.

items.name: JSONBuilder
items.summary: A builder for a JSON lines printer.

methods.name: always_begin_end
methods.signature: fn always_begin_end(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut JSONBuilder
methods.summary: When enabled, the `begin` and `end` messages are always emitted, even when no match is found.

methods.name: build
methods.signature: fn build<W: io::Write>(&self, wtr: W) -> JSON<W>
methods.summary: Create a JSON printer that writes results to the given writer.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new() -> JSONBuilder
methods.summary: Return a new builder for configuring the JSON printer.

methods.name: pretty
methods.signature: fn pretty(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut JSONBuilder
methods.summary: Print JSON in a pretty printed format.

methods.name: replacement
methods.signature: fn replacement(&mut self, replacement: Option<Vec<u8>>) -> &mut JSONBuilder
methods.summary: Set the bytes that will be used to replace each occurrence of a match found.

items.summary: An implementation of `Sink` associated with a matcher and an optional file path for the JSON printer.

methods.name: begin
methods.signature: fn begin(&mut self, _searcher: &Searcher) -> Result<bool, io::Error>

methods.name: binary_byte_offset

methods.summary: If binary data was found in the previous search, this returns the offset at which the binary data was first detected.

methods.name: binary_data
methods.signature: fn binary_data(&mut self, searcher: &Searcher, binary_byte_offset: u64) -> Result<bool, io::Error>
